source_fits.source: Bergmann et al. 2024 DOI 10.1007/s40544-024-0887-2 Eq 6 and Sec 6.2; source-condition fit, NOT 50 C or granular calibration

pressure_bound.cap_status: HYPOTHETICAL upper local pressure; not yield strength, wear limit or safety approval
pressure_bound.other_status: HYPOTHETICAL combined non-adhesive contribution; not the paper measured deformative component

geometry.status: HYPOTHETICAL linear roots + independent frictionless elastic Hertz contacts; NOT calibrated to material or snow
geometry.height_distribution: uniform height bins, midpoint quadrature; weights are contact counts, not success probabilities
geometry.small_contact_status: a/R <= 0.1 is illustrative Hertz small-contact screen only; no material linearity/yield check implied
geometry.radius_definition: local crown curvature radius, not complete particle radius; shallow crowns may have curvature radius larger than grain

cost.status: ALL cost inputs are sensitivity assumptions, NOT vendor quotes, phase coverage or load fraction

load_sharing.status: HYPOTHETICAL load-weighted friction illustration; NOT measured coefficients, phase mass fraction or coverage
